stories.title: Presidential Prerogative or Imperial Demolition? Roberts Lets the $400M Ballroom Keep Rising
stories.conservative_headline: Chief Justice Slaps Down Activist Judges Trying to Halt Trump's Privately Funded White House Ballroom
stories.liberal_headline: Roberts Green-Lights Trump's $400 Million Vanity Project as Courts Say It Was Never Legal
stories.poll_question: Should courts be able to halt White House construction projects?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Presidents control the grounds; judges have no business stopping a donor-funded project.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Historic preservation and review laws apply to presidents too.

stories.title: Trimming Fraud or Starving Families? SNAP Rolls Plunge 13% in a Year

stories.liberal_headline: Millions Lose Food Aid as Red Tape and Fear Purge SNAP Rolls Faster Than Anyone Predicted
stories.poll_question: Is the SNAP enrollment drop good news?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Fewer people need aid when work rules and integrity checks are enforced.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Eligible families are being kicked off by paperwork, not lifted out of poverty.

stories.title: Ballot Integrity or Vote Suppression? Trump Asks SCOTUS to Curtail Mail Voting

stories.poll_question: Can a president restrict mail-in voting by executive order?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Mail voting invites fraud; federal action is needed to protect elections.
stories.poll_option2_desc: The Constitution gives states and Congress election authority, not the president.

stories.title: Accountability or Purge? Pentagon Fires Stars and Stripes Editor, Publisher and Reporter

stories.liberal_headline: Pentagon Guts Independent Military Newspaper's Leadership in Blatant Assault on Press Freedom
stories.poll_question: Was firing Stars and Stripes leadership justified?
stories.poll_option1_desc: The Pentagon funds it and can set its editorial direction and staffing.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Firing editors over coverage silences the troops' own independent newspaper.

stories.title: Honoring a President or Erasing a Hero? Navy Weighs Trump Name Over Pearl Harbor Sailor

stories.liberal_headline: Navy May Strip Black Pearl Harbor Hero's Name From Carrier to Flatter Trump
stories.poll_question: Who should the new aircraft carrier be named for?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Presidents who rebuilt the Navy have long been honored with carriers.
stories.poll_option2_desc: A Pearl Harbor hero's legacy shouldn't be traded for political flattery.

stories.title: Real Insurance or Legal Cover? ICE Floats $500K Liability Policies for Local Deputies
stories.conservative_headline: ICE Backs Up Local Cops With Liability Protection So They Can Enforce the Law Without Fear
stories.liberal_headline: ICE Plans Half-Million-Dollar Insurance for Deputized Officers Accused of Misconduct in Immigration Raids

stories.poll_option1_desc: Cops shouldn't be bankrupted by lawsuits for enforcing federal immigration law.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Taxpayer-funded insurance removes any consequence for abusive immigration arrests.

stories.poll_question: Is noncitizen voting a real threat to US elections?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Only citizens should vote, and rolls need aggressive verification now.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Studies show noncitizen voting is vanishingly rare; this report is politicized.

stories.poll_option1_desc: Crushing inflation now protects paychecks and savings for the long run.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Workers are losing jobs while Washington ignores a stalling labor market.

stories.poll_option2_desc: Parents want schools focused on learning, not book bans and ideology.

stories.poll_option2_desc: Weakening libel protections lets the powerful sue critical coverage into silence.
